In the structure of the Nb – Si – X (50–) alloy after HIP , three main components were found by the method of x-ray structure analysis and x-ray structure microanalysis: a solid solution based on niobium (Nb, X) solid sol. that forms a matrix
a solid solution based on (Nb, X)5Si3 silicide in the form of particles of a round shape with a size of 1 – 3 /c109m
and (Hf, X )O2 particles of a round shape with a size of 0.5 – 1.5 /c109m (Fig. 1). Particles of silicide and hafnium oxide are located inside the matrix, without forming an ordered structure.
A niobium based solid solution and silicide precipitations form eutectic colonies with a diameter of 40 – 70 /c109m close in shape to the sphere.
The silicide corresponds to the for- mula (Nb, X ) 3Si.

attributes.morphology: round particles, groups at colony boundaries
